name: Cycle of Rebirth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

adventurer, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
narrative.objectives: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah? adventurer, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and you shall see the power that these seeds will do for the land. Only those pure and true can heal the land?

<Tammra begins to chant.>
narrative.requestItemsText: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. The least I can do is perform the cycle of rebirth and sow the Gaea seeds to replenish the lands with a new forest. Do you have the required Gaea seeds, Champion?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 23 to 25, 3,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Cycle of Rebirth
quests.objectiveText: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

quests.name: New Life
quests.objectiveText: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
